items.headline: Hyperscaler Q1 capex prints above consensus; AI infra orders accelerate
items.summary: The four largest cloud providers reported Q1 capex roughly 8% above consensus, with management commentary emphasizing AI infrastructure as the primary driver and forward orders extending into 2027.

items.headline: DOJ extends antitrust review of NVIDIA's networking-stack bundling
items.summary: DOJ requested additional information on how NVIDIA prices its InfiniBand and Spectrum-X networking products when sold alongside GPUs. Review extension adds an estimated three to six months; no formal complaint filed.

items.headline: Foundry partner reports 3nm yield improvement, ahead of plan
items.summary: TSMC disclosed defect-density improvements on its N3P node that should support higher GPU output in H2. Supply analysts read it as easing the bottleneck on NVIDIA's data-center allocation.

items.headline: Insider selling: VP of Sales files for ~$8M secondary
items.summary: Filing shows a planned 10b5-1 sale by an SVP-level executive. Aggregate size remains small relative to insider holdings and prior sales by other officers in the quarter.

items.headline: Sovereign AI deal with Saudi PIF for 100k GPUs disclosed
items.summary: Public Investment Fund will purchase approximately 100,000 H200-class GPUs over an 18-month delivery schedule for a state-backed AI cluster, with options to expand.
